considered_not_added: Azvudine NMPA package insert (阿兹夫定片说明书, conditional approval 2021-07; pivotal Phase 2 = NCT04109183, 172 ART-naive patients, HIV-1 RNA <50 copies/mL at week 48): a regulator-document patient-side record for the existing hiv-nrti-cell-culture-panel track (model side Wang 2014, 10.1371/journal.pone.0105617), not a new model system; it belongs as a 2021 `same` entry on that track for engagement and efficacy (tier pending rule question 1), so it is out of scope for added_models.

In-vitro M184I resistance selection (Wang 2014) vs M184I after short-term azvudine for COVID-19 in people with HIV (Jiang et al., AIDS 2023;37(8):1341-2, PMID 37930315, 10.1097/QAD.0000000000003564; letter, no abstract, not open access, full text not read): in-vitro resistance selection is already part of the cell-culture panel's model description, so this is a patient-level resistance comparison on the existing track (imported_from COVID-19), not a distinct system.

Azvudine thymus-homing tissue distribution in rat and SARS-CoV-2-infected rhesus macaques (Acta Pharm Sin B 2024, PMID 39027259; Zhang 2021 STTT macaque model): COVID-19 indication; no HIV patient comparison of thymic enrichment or CD4 protection found; not an HIV model.

FNC acute toxicity in BALB/c mice, OECD-423 (APJCP 2023, PMID 37378948): post-approval single-dose rodent study with no patient comparison stated and no prediction tied to the label's adverse reactions; no source puts it beside patient data.

FNC PBMC-triphosphate retention and A3G restoration in FNC-treated patients (J Med Chem 2020, PMID 32678592): intracellular triphosphate persistence is the cell-culture dose track already in the draft; the A3G/Vif finding is a mechanism observed in patients with no prior model prediction to compare.

Rat/dog plasma PK and Caco-2/rat intestinal absorption of FNC (PMID 24999865, 28487144, 30223932): bioanalytical and absorption work with no stated human-dose prediction and no patient comparison found.
HIV-2 in-vitro activity of censavudine (PMID 26392486) and azvudine (Wang 2014): no HIV-2 patients were dosed with either drug; no comparison exists.

Patient-derived isolate phenotyping used to enrol NRTI-resistant patients in the GS-9131 Phase 2 (NCT03472326): the same cell-culture system with clinical isolates, already in the panel's description; no new system and no peer-reviewed isolate paper beyond CROI posters.
Humanized-mouse or SIV/SHIV macaque efficacy model: none found for azvudine, censavudine or GS-9131 in HIV.
In-silico PK/PD, PBPK or QSP dose-selection model: none found for any member in HIV (azvudine population-PK work is in COVID-19).
Human challenge or human genetic model: not applicable to NRTIs; none found.
Censavudine healthy-volunteer single-ascending-dose Phase 1 (PMID 24374821): human PK only; the abstract states no animal-PK-based dose prediction, so it adds nothing to a new track.
CL-197 first-in-human (AAC 2026, PMID 42695945): not a class member.
Earlier public date for the GS-9131 termination (Adis 2020-04-28): a dating question on an existing entry, not a model system.
